title: Not Recommended to Use Git LFS for Website Projects

children.value: Website projects like React, Next, Vue, Nuxt typically contain some image files (e.g. logos), but usually not too many.
After using Git LFS, you may find corrupted images when only using
to pull the project to server.
Although you can try commands like
to fix, server operations are less convenient than local.
When deploying my Nuxt website to server, I encountered corrupted images. After using
, the PNG files existed on server but showed completely transparent empty images when accessed via URL.
Avoiding Git LFS will save your time and effort.
